mapper.sql: select organization.tenant_id, organization.revision, organization.created_by, organization.created_time, organization.updated_by, organization.updated_time, organization.deleted_flag, organization.deleted_by, organization.deleted_time, user1.nick_name as leader_name,organization.syn_type, organization.id, organization.remark, organization.organization_name, organization.order_num, organization.leader_id, organization.status, organization.organization_code from system_organization as organization
mapper.select:
left join system_user_base as user1 on organization.leader_id = user1.id
organization.deleted_flag = 'N' and organization.remark like concat('%', #{remark}, '%') and organization.organization_name like concat('%', #{organizationName}, '%') and organization.order_num = #{orderNum} and organization.leader_id = #{leaderId} and organization.status = #{status} and organization.organization_code like concat('%', #{organizationCode}, '%')
and organization.syn_type = #{synType}
and
( organization.organization_name like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or organization.remark like concat('%', #{item}, '%') or organization.organization_code like concat('%', #{item}, '%') )
order by organization.created_time desc

select userServiceOrg.tenant_id, userServiceOrg.revision, userServiceOrg.created_by, userServiceOrg.created_time, userServiceOrg.updated_by, userServiceOrg.updated_time, userServiceOrg.deleted_flag, userServiceOrg.deleted_by, userServiceOrg.deleted_time, userServiceOrg.id, userServiceOrg.remark, organization.organization_name, userServiceOrg.data_scope,userServiceOrg.department_id,userServiceOrg.organization_id from system_organization as organization left JOIN system_user_service_org as userServiceOrg on organization.id = userServiceOrg.organization_id and userServiceOrg.deleted_flag = 'N' WHERE organization.deleted_flag = 'N' and userServiceOrg.deleted_flag = 'N' and organization.status = 1 and userServiceOrg.user_id = #{userId}

select organization.tenant_id, organization.revision, organization.created_by, organization.created_time, organization.updated_by, organization.updated_time, organization.deleted_flag, organization.deleted_by, organization.deleted_time, organization.id, organization.id as organization_id, organization.remark, organization.organization_name from system_organization as organization WHERE organization.deleted_flag = 'N' and organization.status = 1

select organization.tenant_id, organization.revision, organization.created_by, organization.created_time, organization.updated_by, organization.updated_time, organization.deleted_flag, organization.deleted_by, organization.deleted_time, organization.id, organization.organization_code, organization.remark, organization.organization_name from system_organization as organization WHERE organization.deleted_flag = 'N' and organization.organization_code = #{code}
